script: Nobody noticed this. In the GTA 6 trailer there is a timer counting down from 47 seconds, and it never resets. Rockstar does not put dead props on screen. Watch the garage scene again.

Everyone says the trailer is pre-rendered. It is not. You can see draw distance pop on the bridge at 38 seconds. That means it runs on the engine, and Rockstar never shows engine footage more than 18 months before launch.
Nadie está hablando de esto. El mapa filtrado en 2022 coincide exactamente con la toma del aeropuerto del nuevo trailer. Son tres fuentes independientes apuntando a lo mismo.
